STRICT_VERIFICATION: STRICT VERIFICATION (client instruction, 12 Nov 2026): zero tolerance for invented content. Every case name, citation, date, bench, section number, rule, notification, rate, time limit and quote must be confirmed from at least two independent sources opened in this run (court or official site plus a reliable reporter such as Live Law, Bar and Bench, SCC Online blog, Indian Kanoon, India Code, official gazettes).
